verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only shows webhook triggers for Workflow Builder (starting a workflow from outside Slack via a webhook), which can be configured to post a message, but this requires building a workflow rather than the classic simple 'incoming webhook URL that posts to a channel' feature. No direct documentation of a dedicated Incoming Webhooks app/URL is present in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit incoming webhook app documentation, a simple curl/webhook-to-channel example, and independent confirmation that this simple posting mechanism works as described.
